items.subject: Prompt Injection Vulnerability in Ollama, Gemma4 and HuggingFace's Transformers
items.what_happened: A community report describes a prompt injection vulnerability affecting Ollama, the Gemma4 model, and HuggingFace Transformers. Operators running these components in self-hosted inference stacks should review the report and validate untrusted input handling in their serving paths; the claim is from a Reddit post and has not been confirmed by a vendor advisory.
items.why_it_matters: Classified as breaking for on-prem operators: action may be required on ollama, transformers, gemma4
items.rationale: Assess exposure before the next upgrade window

items.subject: Flowise Is Shutting Down
items.what_happened: Flowise, the self-hostable low-code LLM app builder often deployed in front of local vLLM/Ollama endpoints, announced it is shutting down. Operators running Flowise on-prem should plan migration to an alternative orchestration layer and expect no further updates or security patches.
items.why_it_matters: Classified as breaking for on-prem operators: action may be required on flowise
items.rationale: Assess exposure before the next upgrade window
